type:
∀ (nu : Real),
  GT.gt nu 0 →
    Exists fun u₀ =>
      Exists fun f =>
        And (NavierStokes.InitialVelocityConditionDecay u₀)
          (And (NavierStokes.ForceConditionDecay f)
            (Not (Exists fun v => Exists fun p => NavierStokes.NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn nu u₀ f v p)))
